issues.title: useActionState hook causes hydration mismatch when server action throws
issues.aiSummary: Server action failure during SSR fails to serialize rejection payload to client stream, causing mismatch at client boundary.
issues.body: When a server action throws an error during initial render, the client reconciliation logic fails to catch the boundary and throws a hydration mismatch error instead of unwrapping the error boundary.

issues.title: RFC: Standardized View Transition Primitives for Concurrent Transitions
issues.aiSummary: Proposal to introduce `<ViewTransition>` component to synchronize CSS View Transitions API with React Suspense and Transitions.
issues.body: This proposal defines how the Document View Transitions API coordinates with React's concurrent scheduler.

issues.title: Compiler: Memoization bail-out in loops with nested destructuring
issues.aiSummary: Optimisation pass fails to infer immutable bindings when array destructuring is used inside a mapped loop.
issues.body: The React Compiler aborts memoization when detecting complex destructuring inside iterator expressions.

issues.title: Support AsyncLocalStorage in Node.js server component runtime
issues.aiSummary: Propagate AsyncLocalStorage context across React Server Component async dispatch boundaries automatically.
issues.body: Context variables stored inside AsyncLocalStorage should be preserved when async React Server Components yield control to asynchronous microtasks.

issues.title: Fix memory leak in useSyncExternalStore with rapidly updating subscriptions
issues.aiSummary: Unsubscribe callback was not cleaned up during unmount if pending transition interrupted component tree unmounting.
issues.body: Resolved by ensuring subscriber cleanup handlers execute unconditionally during concurrent fiber destruction.

issues.title: Dialog: focus trap breaks on Safari with virtual keyboard
issues.aiSummary: Mobile Safari viewport resizing during virtual keyboard display pushes focus container off-screen without re-centering.
issues.body: On iOS Safari 17.4, triggering an input inside a Dialog with autofocus moves the active element outside the visible viewport.
